# Marketing Campaign

Curated by Skill Harbor: an end-to-end campaign orchestration skill that plans and executes multi-channel product launches from a single brief. It runs four phases: research (audience profiling, 3+ competitors mapped, exploitable insights), positioning (core benefit statement, positioning formula, campaign angle, tone profile, with nothing written until the angle is approved), content production in dependency order (landing page copy, email sequence on a problem-to-urgency arc, platform-native LinkedIn and X posts, timestamped short-form video scripts, 3 to 4 ad copy variants, day-by-day content calendar), and review (5-second hero test, CTA audit, tone consistency, claim audit, cross-channel consistency). A hard-ban list kills hollow copy: no "game-changing", no "cutting-edge", no "learn more", no fake urgency. Pure Markdown skill: no code runs on install. Pairs with brand-voice, content-engine, crosspost, market-research, and seo from the same ECC family (lots 50 and 51). By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: it is a planning and copy framework, not media buying or analytics; the output quality depends on the research you feed it. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
